threads.subject: URGENT: Production Disruption — Lahore Snack Lines

messages.body: URGENT: Our Lahore manufacturing facility is experiencing a partial work stoppage. Snack production lines (Lays, Kurkure, Cheetos, Doritos) are impacted. We are working to resolve but cannot guarantee dispatch timelines for orders depending on Lahore production. Orders already in transit are unaffected. New orders for Lahore-manufactured SKUs will be delayed minimum 48-72 hours. We apologize for the inconvenience and will provide updates every 6 hours.

threads.impact: 48-72 hour delay on new orders for Lahore-manufactured SKUs
